body.name: N_Ge
body.def: \(\mathcal N_{G,e}\) is a source-parametric dominance certificate showing that the \(\lambda_e\)-projection of a positive-dimensional irreducible component of the generic covariance fiber is Zariski dense in \(\mathbb A^1_{K_G}\), and hence that \(\lambda_e\) is transcendental over \(K_G\).
